question.prompt: Using the origin \(O\) as the center of homothety, enlarge point \(P(3,-1)\) by a factor of \(2\), with the corresponding point \(P'\) and \(P\) on opposite sides of the center of homothety. Find the coordinates of \(P'\). Enter the horizontal coordinate first, followed by the vertical coordinate, separated by a comma.

solutions.explanation: For points on opposite sides of the center, multiply the coordinates by \(-2\): \((3\times(-2),-1\times(-2))=(-6,2)\).
solutions.title: Use the negative homothety factor
